examples.base_sql:
SELECT 
    p.tier,
    p.monthly_price_cents,
    COUNT(*) AS count_subscriptions_per_plan_tier,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.tier = 'free' THEN 'small'
        WHEN p.tier = 'starter' THEN 'mid'
        WHEN p.tier = 'pro' THEN 'large'
        WHEN p.tier = 'enterprise' THEN 'large'
    END AS seat_label
FROM plans p
JOIN subscriptions s ON p.plan_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.tier, p.monthly_price_cents
examples.gold_sql: SELECT p.tier, CASE WHEN s.seats <= 11 THEN 'small' WHEN s.seats <= 39 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'large' END AS size, COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.tier, size
examples.question: For cancelled subscriptions, label seat counts 'small' (up to 11), 'mid' (more than 11 up to 39) or 'large' (over 39) and count subscriptions per plan tier and label.
examples.student_sql:
SELECT 
    p.tier,
    p.monthly_price_cents,
    p.seat_limit,
    COUNT(*) AS count_subscriptions_per_plan_tier,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.seat_limit IS NULL THEN 'small' 
        WHEN p.seat_limit <= 11 THEN 'mid' 
        WHEN p.seat_limit > 11 AND p.seat_limit <= 39 THEN 'large' 
        ELSE 'large' 
    END AS seat_label
FROM plans p
JOIN subscriptions s ON p.plan_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.tier, p.monthly_price_cents, p.seat_limit
examples.teacher_sql:
SELECT p.tier,
       CASE
         WHEN s.seats <= 11 THEN 'small'
         WHEN s.seats BETWEEN 12 AND 39 THEN 'mid'
         ELSE 'large'
       END AS size_label,
       COUNT(*) AS subscription_count
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY p.tier, size_label
ORDER BY p.tier, size_label
